basis: Noted difference, possibly different systems: the 2023 report says there is no electronic biometric database with fingerprints, while the migration inspectorate refers to an existing automated information system Fingerprint Register regulated since 2007.

from_text: As part of the IT Development Programme and the National Programme for Accession, a Roadmap and timeline for interoperability with EU information systems, covering the period 2026 -2029 was approved in November 2025.
to_text: For the coming period, the approval of a Roadmap and a timetable for ensuring interoperability with EU information systems is proposed.
basis: Noted difference, possibly different drafting dates: the 2026 report says the roadmap for interoperability with EU information systems was approved in November 2025, while the Government's December 2025 plan still proposes its approval.
